top: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place,
bottom: and hangeth the earth upon nothing.

top: But there is a spirit in man:
bottom: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.

top: When the morning stars sang together,
bottom: and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

top: I know that thou canst do every thing,
bottom: and that no thought can be withholden from thee.

top: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD:
bottom: and he delighteth in his way.

top: I will meditate also of all thy work,
bottom: and talk of thy doings.

top: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name:
bottom: make known his deeds among the people.

top: Go to the ant, thou sluggard;
bottom: consider her ways, and be wise...

top: A soft answer turneth away wrath:
bottom: but grievous words stir up anger.

top: My son, give me thine heart,
bottom: and let thine eyes observe my ways.

top: As cold waters to a thirsty soul,
bottom: so is good news from a far country.

top: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do,
bottom: do it with thy might...

top: they shall beat their swords into plowshares,
bottom: and their spears into pruninghooks...

top: the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow,
bottom: and from thy fear...

top: They shall lift up their voice,
bottom: they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD...

top: Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD,
bottom: and spread it before the LORD.

top: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand,
bottom: saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.

top: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver;
bottom: I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.

top: I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands;
bottom: thy walls are continually before me.

top: And the LORD shall guide thee continually,...
bottom: thou shalt be like a watered garden...

top: But now, O LORD, thou art our father;
bottom: we are the clay, and thou our potter...

top: As one whom his mother comforteth,
bottom: so will I comfort you...

top: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart,
bottom: which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
